film.provenance: Real control-openhands recordings; tight crop shows only popover and blank composer controls, with clear Before/After captions. Short interactions are held to four seconds per scene. No UI state was mocked or synthesized.
film.music: Original locally synthesized quiet ambience: 174.61Hz + 220Hz + 261.63Hz sine tones, 0.004 base amplitude, fades; no licensed recording.

gif.source: Silent inline preview derived from the same component-only MP4, scaled without additional source pixels. This GIF previews the four Before/After scenes; its duration differs from the 18-second MP4.

limits: Live model/backend verification covers local Agent Server + DeepSeek, not Cloud or ACP execution.
The 390px phone popover clips 2px at the left edge both before and after; no page horizontal overflow. Layout is unchanged.
Unchanged neutral/static muted text does not meet 4.5:1 in every theme; warning/danger percentage, fill, and boundary are the scoped contrast fixes.

Phone Usage-bar navigation was observed but not verified: the popover closed without a visible Usage panel after one healthy-doctor retry. This behavior was not re-driven on the baseline; no pre-existing or regression claim is made. Desktop bar/Usage/Escape/outside and Compact context passed.
